arjun: Heads-up: noticed a spike in `quota.errors=missing_attrib` after yesterday's edge-rollout. Some delegated key flows aren't getting project attribution.
lena: can you paste a sample trace id?
arjun: trace=tr_9f3c. Flow: client -> edge -> auth-exchange -> quota. exchange returns 200 but no `x-project-id` header.
max: we intentionally trimmed headers for privacy on public responses. quota expects an internal header.
sre-lee: quick mitigation: have auth-exchange emit signed `X-Attr-V1` internal header and ensure edge strips before responding to clients. That preserves privacy + quota.
arjun: agree. also we should mark those fallback-attrib events with `attrib.repaired=true` so billing pipeline can backfill.
lena: rollout plan? we should gate with feature flag and canary on cluster-d.
max: feature flag `auth.attr_emit_v1` looks good. impl note: use existing KMS signing key with 30s TTL. add metric `auth.attr.emitted`.
sre-lee: will add dashboard panels: missing_attrib ratio, emitted header count, and a reconciliation job status. alert if missing_attrib > 1% for 10m.
deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-exchange v6.3 -> cluster-d (by max)
arjun: thanks. also console UX: show short banner for affected orgs: "We're patching delegated key attribution; you may see temporary rate errors." non-blocking.
max: created GH for header spec + strip rule: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/5189
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: auth-exchange v6.3 -> cluster-d
arjun: will monitor for 30m and report back. thanks all.
